description:
Mahatma Gandhi English High School, founded by Shri Vinayak Deokar, has been providing free English-medium education for the past 12 years to around 650 underprivileged children from Nursery to Grade X in Pune.
The school supports children from vulnerable backgrounds, including children of widows, divorced women, sex workers, prisoners and ailing parents. Students receive free education along with books, uniforms, shoes, stationery, meals, transportation and other essentials.
The organization also runs Destitute’ s Palace, a residential home providing care and support to 45 orphan girls in Lohegaon, Pune.
Requirement & Sponsorship:
Water Tank
Project cost for Underground Water Tank: ₹3,00,000
Cooking Oil
Project cost Rs 1.75 lakhs
Total Project cost Rs 4.75 lakhs.
